time-parse.title: Parse & format timestamps (timezone-aware)
time-parse.pitfall: Parsing wall-clock strings in the server's local zone, or formatting without a zone — silently shifts times across DST and machines.

epoch-convert.title: Convert epoch ↔ date
epoch-convert.pitfall: Mixing seconds and milliseconds — a silent 1000× error that lands you in 1970 or the year 52000.

jwt-verify.title: Verify a JWT
jwt-verify.pitfall: Decoding without verifying the signature, accepting alg:none, not pinning the algorithm (RS→HS key confusion), or skipping exp/aud/iss.

password-hash.title: Hash & verify passwords
password-hash.pitfall: Hashing passwords with SHA-256/MD5 — they are far too fast. Use a slow, salted KDF (bcrypt / scrypt / argon2).

hmac-verify.title: Verify an HMAC signature
hmac-verify.pitfall: Comparing signatures with == / bytes.Equal leaks timing. Use a constant-time compare.

secure-token.title: Generate a secure random token
secure-token.pitfall: math/rand · Math.random() · random.random() are NOT cryptographically secure — never use them for tokens, IDs, or secrets.

base64url.title: Base64url encode / decode
base64url.pitfall: Standard base64 uses + / and = padding, which break in URLs and JWTs. Those use base64url (- _) with no padding.

sql-param.title: Parameterized SQL query
sql-param.pitfall: Building SQL with string concatenation / format = SQL injection. Always use placeholders and let the driver bind values.

retry-backoff.title: Retry with exponential backoff + jitter
retry-backoff.pitfall: Fixed-interval retries stampede a struggling server. Use exponential backoff with jitter, cap the delay, and bound total attempts.
